One click turns the page you are on into cleanly formatted Markdown that you can preview, copy or download right from the side panel. Simple, lightweight, and everything it saves is optimised for AI agents to use.

The Linkly AI Clipper side panel extracting the transcript of a YouTube videoThe Linkly AI Clipper side panel extracting the transcript of a YouTube video

## More Than “Save Page”

Article text, images, translations, video subtitles, even your conversations with AI — all of it becomes one clean Markdown file that any agent can work with. [...] ### Saves Straight to Your Disk

Files download to your computer. If the Linkly AI desktop app is running, they can go straight into your library and be indexed right away.

### Saved in a Format Agents Can Read

Every file carries YAML front matter and a clear section structure, with dedicated handling for sites like X and Weibo. It works on its own as an offline, agent-oriented clipper.

### Images Come Along

Pictures from the article are saved into the same folder, so the piece still reads properly when you are offline.

### Translation on Your Machine

Chrome's built-in translation model runs locally, so there is no API key to set up and nothing leaves your computer. Fast and effortless.

### Doubles as a Reader Mode [...] ### Doubles as a Reader Mode

The side panel preview is a clean reader in its own right: automatic typography, adjustable text size, dark mode, and side-by-side translation.

### AI Fills In the Outline

When a page has no proper heading hierarchy, Chrome's built-in model infers the section titles and builds a readable table of contents.

### Save AI Conversations in One Click

A button appears on ChatGPT and Claude conversation pages, so the exchanges worth keeping are one click away.

### Video Transcripts

Subtitles and transcripts from YouTube, Bilibili and other video sites can be saved too, which makes what was said searchable.

results.content: Linkly AI Clipper is a minimalist browser clipping plugin that converts and downloads the web pages you see into AI-friendly Markdown. You can use it as a minimalist clipping plugin, or combine it with the linkly.ai client to achieve more advanced capabilities. 🚀 Recent Updates (2026-09-03) 1. Plugin adds support for Japanese, French, and Spanish. 2. When clipping WorkBuddy and Claude conversations, each round of Q&A now shows the send time. 3. Fixed an issue where long X (Twitter) posts lost content during clipping. 4. Fixed an issue where charts in answers were not displayed when clipping Claude.ai conversations. 5. Clipping Weibo articles is now cleaner—no more ads and author info outside the main content. 6. Article table of contents recognition is more accurate: subtitles are [...] of contents recognition is more accurate: subtitles are detected more completely, and clicking now jumps correctly. ⭐⭐⭐ Core Features ⭐⭐⭐ 1️⃣ One-click save web pages as Markdown Click download to quickly save web content to your download folder or Linkly Space within one second. It not only extracts the article’s main text but also saves images, author, original link, publish time, source site, and more—saving you the tedious steps of copying, downloading, organizing, and adding sources. 2️⃣ Supports many sites like X/Weibo/YouTube/ChatGPT Exclusive adaptation to different platforms’ content structures lets you save content that ordinary clipping tools struggle to handle fully: ▸ Weibo and X threads and comments ▸ YouTube and Bilibili video subtitles ▸ Mixed text-and-image articles with [...] video subtitles ▸ Mixed text-and-image articles with their images ▸ Complete conversations between you and AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude 3️⃣ Local translation, translate and save instantly Built-in Chrome local translation capability lets you quickly translate while browsing, then clip and save the translated text directly. 4️⃣ Everything saved locally, designed for Agents All clippings are saved locally in Markdown format, naturally ready for your Agent to read. Clipped content can also be automatically published to your Linkly AI cloud library, making it usable by more people’s Agents.

# Clip the web.Keep the markdown.

The MDflow Web Clipper turns any web page into clean Markdown and saves it straight to a folder in your workspace. Highlight what matters, then clip — no copy-paste, no formatting cleanup. It works like the Obsidian Web Clipper, but your notes live in your MDflow account: reachable from any device, your scripts, and your AI agents.

add to your browser ↓./start-free →

$mdflow clip --help

## Three steps to your first clip

01

### Install the extension

Add the MDflow Web Clipper to Chrome, Firefox or Safari — it's a free download from the official store.

02

### Connect once [...] $clip --template

### A template per kind of page

 ›Separate templates for articles, recipes, videos, threads or product pages
 ›Auto-selected by URL pattern or the page's schema.org data
 ›Each template sets the name, folder, content and properties for that source

$clip --ai

### Let an LLM do the busywork

 ›Natural-language prompts summarize, pull quotes, or extract tags as you clip
 ›Bring your own provider and key — Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and more
 ›Requests go straight to your provider; MDflow never sees or stores them

$clip --for-agents

### A second brain your agents can read [...] ### A second brain your agents can read

 ›Every clip lands in your cloud workspace as durable Markdown
 ›The same documents are reachable over the MDflow HTTP API and MCP servers
 ›So Claude, Cursor or Codex can answer from the web research you captured

// Capture the web by hand; let your agents read it back as context.

$mdflow clip --features

## The engine behind the clips

A full-featured clipper — capture, highlight, template and AI — not a bookmark button.

$clip --page
